explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX?

i need to explain the word XXXXX and its meaning. it is an adjective, not a noun. i found a phrase, but it doesn't seem to contain the word XXXXX.

a:

it is an adjective describing a tool with a blade or blade-like section. 
and a blade is a similar concept.

from http://www.learnwithwords.com/editions/XXXXX.html

a:

from the dictionary on line 5:

a.

adj.
1. of or pertaining to blades or arms, esp. those of a weapon and particularly in swordsmanship; especially a guard, a lock, or a thrust; especially on the person of a person

[from http://www.learnwithwords.com/lexicon/sword.html]

dictionary.com on line 12:

an. (of a weapon or blade) a short metal blade on a sword; a guard; a lock
a. (of something) a sword, a lock, or a guard
b. a sword (one of the weapons)
c. a lock
d. (of, pertaining to, or resembling a sword)
